title: BIfTI Phantom Catalog
description: Living, freely PR-editable discovery list: a top-level object mapping a human-readable label to an immutable registry collection name ('<author>-<name>-<number>', see bifti-registry.schema.json). Tools list only the collections named here, then resolve each to its registry name for addressing. Adding, updating, and removing entries is all allowed; every value must be a current key in registry.json (enforced by tools/validate_catalog.py). Object key order is display order. See REGISTRY.md.

additionalProperties.description: An immutable registry collection name this label resolves to.
